contract: NoTrace delegates to BuildRhsNodeLevel; -1 remains the no-node sentinel.
hard_rule: Do not add a NoTrace-specific fallback that creates node shapes Trace would reject.

contract: Whole-call arg nodes are all-or-nothing; any arg -1 keeps callArgNodeStart at sentinel.
hard_rule: Do not partially populate callArgNodeStart/callArgNodeCount after an arg builder returns -1.

contract: WholeCall returns -1 for unsupported shape; downstream consumers must treat it as contract, not bug.
hard_rule: Do not relax WholeCall unsupported-shape gates without first updating every consumer contract and full ZC delta.

contract: Field call-arg materializer expects no-node cases and hard-fails unsupported field metadata.
hard_rule: Do not make field materialization accept new owner/type shapes as a fallback for missing rhsNodeIndex.

contract: Indexed-member address walker is a strict consumer; non aggregate/ptr base, unsupported index, or bad field metadata returns false.
hard_rule: Do not widen base-kind acceptance such as LocalStrTag outside the op-lane campaign and ZC delta gate.

contract: Call-arg lowering drills through known unary wrappers; missing arg node falls to strict field/index materializers.
hard_rule: Do not treat r3DrillCallNode=-1 as permission to synthesize untyped call args.

contract: CallExpr node-eval accepts only fully typed call facts; any shape/ordinal/arg mismatch records a NodeEvalMiss and returns false.
hard_rule: Do not add string-runtime kernel construction or ordinal fallback after any side-effectful call emission.

contract: NodeEval miss is an explicit hard-fail accounting surface for unsupported node lowering.
hard_rule: Do not suppress NodeEvalMissAt to make reports look green.

contract: Statement lowering branches on rhsNodeIndex >= 0 / -1; changing producer sentinel changes these consumers.
hard_rule: Do not reinterpret rhsNodeIndex=-1 globally; each branch must keep its existing statement-kind contract.
